description.value: Trail Coffee Co. is a downtown Trail café and in-house roastery serving fair-trade, organic espresso drinks alongside a from-scratch breakfast and lunch menu of sandwiches, wraps, and salads. The shop roasts its own beans on-site and sells them retail and wholesale, making it a genuine local coffee destination in the West Kootenays. Cyclists passing through Trail will find a full meal, quality espresso, and online ordering for quick pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, full-service coffee shop and in-house roastery at 1369 Cedar Ave in downtown Trail, BC, with phone (250) 368 5770 and an online ordering system offering pickup or dine-in. The OSM name 'Trail Coffee & Tea Co.' diverges from the website's consistent branding as 'Trail Coffee Co.' throughout all pages. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appears anywhere on the site, so those fields are null; vegetarian menu items are confirmed from the published menu.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Trail Coffee & Tea Co.' but the website consistently uses 'Trail Coffee Co.' on all pages — the '& Tea' portion appears outdated or incorrect.
OSM record has no phone number; phone (250) 368 5770 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café and roastery in downtown Trail with confirmed online presence, full menu, and takeout — a natural stop for touring cyclists in the Kootenays.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes clearly vegetarian items: The Gardener Wrap (chickpeas, artichokes, vegetables, no meat), Avo Toast, Bagel & Spread, and Green Goddess Salad. No explicit vegan or GF labelling on the published menu

wow_evidence: genuine local coffee destination in the West Kootenays; roasts its own beans on-site
